Problem: 当事件A和B同时发生时C也发生. Means if A and B occur simultaneously then C also occurs. So event A∩B ⊆ C. Need which expression holds.
Options:
A. P(C)=P(A∩B)
B. P(C) ≤ P(A)+P(B)-1
C. P(C)=P(A∪B)
D. P(C) ≥ P(A)+P(B)-1

Since A∩B ⊆ C, P(C) ≥ P(A∩B). Need relation P(A∩B) ≥ P(A)+P(B)-1 by inclusion-exclusion: P(A∩B) = P(A)+P(B)-P(A∪B) ≥ P(A)+P(B)-1. Therefore P(C) ≥ P(A)+P(B)-1. Thus D.

Check B reversed. A false unless C exactly AB, no. C false. D true. Need provide concise explanation in Chinese. Final line format. Ensure last line exactly.
content:
由题意“事件 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 同时发生时 \(C\) 也发生”可知：

\[
A\cap B \subseteq C
\]

因此：

\[
P(C)\ge P(A\cap B)
\]

又由概率关系：

\[
P(A\cap B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A\cup B)\ge P(A)+P(B)-1
\]

所以：

\[
P(C)\ge P(A)+P(B)-1
\]

因此成立的是选项 D。

答案：D
